title: Design: Canned job warning looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an inactive part for this test, part A, and an active part for this test, part B.
  • Have a canned job, canned job 1, that holds part A and part B.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, with one line.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 6.4 and 6.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click work order 1.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Type the start of canned job 1's title in the Title box.
  4. Click canned job 1 in the list.
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Wait 10 seconds without closing the message.
  7. Click Close on the message.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The New Line window opens.

Step 3:

  • The list under Title offers canned job 1 with its rate and "Total Parts: 2".

Step 4:

  • Canned job 1's title fills the Title box.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the new line shows on the work order with part B and without part A.
  • An orange message box appears with a white "!" icon at its left and "Close" at its right.
  • The message box sits at the bottom right of the page.
  • It reads "These parts are inactive and were not added:" followed by part A's part number and a full stop.

Step 6:

  • The orange message is still on screen.

Step 7:

  • The orange message disappears.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R9: “Applying a canned job adds the job without its inactive parts.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Canned job leaves out inactive parts | "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "6.4 A canned job that holds it", "6.5 The canned job leaves it out". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

  • daily-05-p6-2-canned-warning.png

The design's own words:

  • “New Line on S2-9647, picking the canned job "Replace - Steering shaft u joints", which includes GREASETUBE.”
  • “The line is added without GREASETUBE (S9-R9), and the user sees one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: GREASETUBE." Each part is named by the inventory part's own number (S9-R10b). The warning stays until the user closes it (S9-R10).”
